La Réserve Firenze has been named Top Luxury Hotel at the 46th Gold Key Awards for Excellence in Hospitality Design. The winners were announced this weekend, from a field of more than 425 entries. The result comes less than a month after the hotel opened its doors on 19 October 2026.

## A palazzo of six apartments

La Réserve Firenze sits on Via Santo Spirito, in the Oltrarno district, with its top floor looking over the Arno. It occupies Palazzo Segni, a 15th-century building bought in 2022 by Olivia and Grégory Marciano, who have lived in Florence since 2019.

The restoration was led by the interior architects Gilles & Boissier. Frescoes were restored by hand, and coffered ceilings, terracotta floors and Siena travertine set the tone. The owners added works from their own collection.

There are only six apartments, from one to three bedrooms, each between roughly 170 and 210 square metres. The largest comes with a rooftop terrace of 55 square metres. There is no restaurant: room service comes from Cammillo, the trattoria on the same street, and a private chef can be booked.

## Service at house scale

La Réserve, the group founded by Michel Reybier, runs the palazzo for its owners and has placed it in its Private Homes collection. Eighteen people look after the six apartments. Housekeeping was trained by Marie-Fleur Raynard-Laude, the group's housekeeping director and a Meilleur Ouvrier de France.

## The other winners

The luxury hotel runners-up were Six Senses London, set in the former Whiteley's department store, and Shangri-La Kunming. The top resort prize went to Four Seasons Resort & Residences AMAALA at Triple Bay, in Saudi Arabia, designed by Goddard Littlefair.

## The signal

The smallest address in the race won. Six apartments beat hotels many times their size, on the strength of restoration, detail and a staff ratio of three people per apartment. For owners of heritage buildings in European cities, it is a model worth watching: fewer keys, more space, and service at the scale of a private house.

Congratulations to the teams of La Réserve Firenze and to every hotel recognised this year.
summary: Less than a month after opening, the six-apartment palazzo in the Oltrarno wins the design awards' top luxury hotel prize, ahead of Six Senses London and Shangri-La Kunming.
title: La Réserve Firenze named Top Luxury Hotel at the 2026 Gold Key Awards
why: A six-apartment address beats far larger hotels on design, a month after opening.
